text: Hey there, I'm Samy from Binance. If you're ready to unlock all the features Binance has to offer, you'll need to verify your account by completing KYC Know youw Customer. From the drop down menu, select Account and then Identification to start the verification process. You'll see a button that says Get Verified. Click that and you'll be prompted to select your country of residence. This is important because it determines which documents you'll need to submit. Most users will need to provide a government issued ID like a passport or driver's licenses, and sometimes proof of address. Just follow the instructions and upload your clear photos of your documents. After submitting, Binance may ask you to complete a quick face verification. You'll need to use your webcam or phone camera to scan your face, which helps ensure you're the one completing the verification. Please enable camera access on your device. Next, Binance will ask for some personal details like your full name, nationality, date of birth and address. Make sure the information matches what's on your ID documents. Once you've submitted everything, Binance will review your documents. This usually takes a few minutes, depending on traffic. You'll get a notification once your account is verified and that's it.
